name: Crunchy persimmon
summary: Crunchy persimmon sold as a gift from the Da Lat orchards.
origin: Vietnam Tourism says visitors buy hồng giòn as a gift because the fruit is sweet and aromatic.
taste: The garden article says the gift fruit is sweet and aromatic. The September article says freshly picked fruit is sweet, soft, and juicy. Both lines are printed.
howToEat: Eat it fresh, or carry it home. The garden article puts persimmon season in late October and November. The September article says the crunchy season runs from September through December.
where: Orchards at the end of Mimosa Pass. The September article also names roads around Cau Dat tea hills and orchard cafes. A kilogram price is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Crunchy persimmon sold as a gift from the Da Lat orchards.
